notes: ConditionalsToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Conditionals (COND) with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no owner, further minting, transfer fees, pause, blocklist or upgrade mechanism. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. The paired currency is IMD. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
